about_the_game:
Stuck in a program (bug) I developed?

---

One day, I woke up from my sleep and woke up in an unknown space. 

When I opened my eyes, the AI P and V I made asked me to fix the bug here... 

Turns out the buggy program I made? 

I can't fix the bug I made to get back to the original world... but I decide to do an emergency recovery! 

Let's gather cryptographic data for emergency recovery and get everything back to where it was and escape!

---

Is it possible to escape to the original world by solving puzzles in a space scattered with data?

Solve the action puzzle with me, and P and V!

Solve action puzzles with 16 stages in your own way and meet hidden stories.

---

Me and my artificial intelligence P, V start the search operation!

name: Anti V Reboot

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 64bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8300H CPU @ 2.30GHz 2.30GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Can Use Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: <Anti V: Reboot> is a puzzle-action game where you explore the computer world with antivirus programs P and V to recover "my" lost memories. Experience the comedic adventures alongside P, who is calm and kind but occasionally cheeky, and V, who is cute and energetic but a total troublemaker.
